application_note: Root reported successful application of all five guarded rescue rows before this read-only verification. verified_at records the verification time, not an invented exact mutation timestamp.
scope: Original 137 reviewed published bean IDs only; later bean imports are excluded.
active_products_query: select count(*) as active_roasted_products, count(*) filter (where requires_review = false) as active_reviewed_roasted_products from public.roasted_products where status in ('available','low_stock');
sensory_count_rule: Requires a source URL and at least one numeric sensory metric. Non-null empty JSON objects do not count.
